summary.text: Anduril Industries is a defense technology contractor specializing in autonomous systems, counter-UAS (Lattice OS), and maritime robotics. Founded in 2017 by Palmer Luckey and Trae Stephens (Founders Fund), it scaled rapidly via venture syndicates and defense procurement awards, surpassing a $30B valuation by 2025. Its relationship with sovereign capital bridges early strategic investment from In-Q-Tel with multi-billion-dollar enterprise contracts across the U.S. Army, SOCOM, and the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU).

facts.claim: In March 2026, the U.S. Army awarded Anduril Industries a 10-year enterprise contract with a ceiling of up to $20B consolidating over 120 prior procurement actions.
In January 2022, U.S. Special Operations Command awarded Anduril a 10-year counter-unmanned systems integration contract with a ceiling of ~$967.6M.
In-Q-Tel took a strategic equity position in Anduril in August 2017 alongside its initial seed round.

connections.claim: Founders Fund led Anduril's 2017 seed round, Series A, and Series G ($1B commitment). Partner Trae Stephens serves as chairman.
In-Q-Tel holds a strategic equity stake in Anduril dating to 2017.
DIU awarded Anduril a 5-year Production Other Transaction (P-OT) agreement for counter-UAS with a $99M ceiling in 2021.
